svg.title: The normalized radial variable is also exact since cm = Nmhm. For continuum heat-uniform oscillation let HD,a(q) = e−a∥q∥2MD(q), a ≥0, where MD is the normalized smooth annular symbol supported in 1/2 ≤∥q∥≤3. Every fixed derivative order has a common bound on that annulus, uniform in a. Indeed with y = √a q, order i derivatives of the heat factor are ai/2 times Gaussian derivatives. For ∥y∥≤1, √a ≤2 gives compact bounds; for ∥y∥≥1, √a ≤2∥y∥and rapid decay give the same bound. Leibniz with MD finishes it.
